name: Monash Resident Scholarship
summary: Covers a year of standard room fees in the Clayton or Peninsula residential village for undergraduates in hardship, Indigenous, remote or asylum-seeking students.
key: One year of standard room fees at Clayton or Peninsula, with 50 available.
who: Commencing or continuing undergraduate at a Monash campus in Australia.
Experiencing financial hardship, Indigenous, from a remote area, or seeking asylum.
how: Apply to Monash University Accommodation for a room, and apply through VTAC SEAS or directly to Monash.
catches: One year only. It can't be deferred.

evidence.quote: Accommodation fees to the value of a standard room in the Clayton or Peninsula Residential Village, for one year only.
